title: How Fintech is Reshaping Our $4T Healthcare Industry

reader_summary.headline: Welcome to part two of our series about the emerging intersection between healthcare and fintech.
reader_summary.overview: Welcome to part two of our series about the emerging intersection between healthcare and fintech. If you're just catching up, in part one, we chatted with A16Z general partners, Julie U and David Haber, about the current state of health care. So today, in part two, we wanted to place you right in the action, where founders, are already building.

thesis: The episode argues that the healthcare industry faces a crisis of opacity where approximately 50% of invoiced dollars remain uncollected, causing financial distress for providers and suffering for patients. It posits that new regulations like the Price Transparency Act are enabling fintech solutions to address this by making pricing data more accessible, which will eventually allow providers to compete on quality and trust rather than billing complexity.
